character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A highly detailed, full-body pixel art character sprite of the 'Mago' class, inspired by the top-left figure in image_23.png. The character is a traditional fantasy wizard, standing in a composed, three-quarter view, centered against a solid, neutral grey background. The sprite maintains the classic 16-bit to 32-bit retro JRPG aesthetic and detailed pixel shading established in image_23.png. The mage is dressed in an ornate, dark indigo blue robe with heavy, burnished gold trim and filigree, and intricate, geometric golden patterns covering the chest and sleeves. A dark brown leather cowl/hood is drawn up, framing a focused, slightly rugged face with dark hair and a serious expression. A heavy brown leather satchel with a buckle and small pouches is strapped across his waist. In his right hand, he holds the prominent wooden staff, carved with gnarled, dark wood patterns and topped with a large, faceted, glowing sapphire crystal, exactly like in image_23.png. In his left hand, he holds a small, closed, leather-bound book with a golden emblem. The lighting is dominated by the glowing staff crystal and soft, directional light. The character sprite is proportional to the characters in image_23.png. Anti-aliasing and precise dithering create depth in the textures.
